findings.location: content.body.steps[id=s6].blocks[1]: «Як перевірити: після tu та el йде іменник»; content.body.steps[id=s1].blocks[0].rows[2][2]: «ustedes — Ви (ввічливо, кільком)».
findings.description: The proposed checking procedure misleadingly suggests that the following word identifies the determiner: adjectives can intervene, as in tu nueva casa and el nuevo libro. Also, Ukrainian capitalized Ви is the respectful form for one person; the explicitly plural translation of ustedes requires lowercase ви.
findings.suggestion: Explain that tu and el determine a noun or noun phrase, with possible intervening modifiers. Change the plural gloss to «ustedes — ви (ввічливо, кільком)».

items.reviewerAnswer: Not applicable: lesson exposition. The ser paradigm is soy, eres, es, somos, sois, son; tú/tu and él/el are distinct.
items.notes: The pronoun and ser paradigms are otherwise correct.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapters 14 on articles and 18 on possessives (from memory).
Український правопис (2019), §60, respectful capitalization of Ви and Ваш when addressing one specific person (from memory).
Course contract, rule 8; review duties concerning misleading simplifications.

findings.description: The explicitly plural Ukrainian gloss incorrectly capitalizes Ви. Respectful capitalization applies to addressing one specific person, whereas several recipients require ви.

items.notes: Nosotros is the correct standard form for the specified mixed pair.
sources: Український правопис (2019), §60, respectful capitalization of Ви and Ваш for one specific addressee (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: «Займенник él тут потрібен, щоб було зрозуміло, хто викладач; yo можна написати або пропустити».
findings.description: The transfer prompt supplies the very subject-omission decisions being assessed: retain él and optionally omit yo. This exposes the target solution before the learner answers.
findings.suggestion: Move the omission explanation into a targeted hint or feedback. For transfer assessment, establish the intended referents through a natural situation and let the learner decide which pronouns to retain.
